mapper.insert:
insert into sale_order_detail(order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, create_time, update_time) values
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.totalPrice},#{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT d.product_id AS productId, d.quantity, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.total_price AS totalPrice, p.name AS productName FROM sale_order_detail d LEFT JOIN product p ON d.product_id = p.id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId}
